name: Fig toast
intro: Thick sourdough, torn burrata, ripe figs, honey, flaky salt. The best five-minute dinner of the summer.

proteins.name: Burrata
proteins.timing: Torn over the hot toast so it starts to soften.

proteins.name: Prosciutto
proteins.timing: Draped over the burrata and figs. Nothing to cook.

proteins.name: Pork chop, leftover
proteins.timing: Under the figs, cold or barely warmed.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet and toast the bread, pressing it down, until golden and crisp.
While it's hot, tear the burrata over it, then add any other protein.
A thread of honey, your flavor, and flaky salt.

leftovers: Toast doesn't keep. Make it fresh.
